results.title: Transforming banking: Examining the role of AI technology ...
results.content: # Transforming banking: Examining the role of AI technology innovation in boosting banks financial performance. We explore how AI innovation in banking impacts banks' financial performance. This research investigates the dynamic relationship between banking and finance artificial intelligence technology innovation and banks' financial performance across 20 countries using the feasible generalized least squares and the generalized method of moments techniques. The results show that banking and finance artificial intelligence technology innovation positively impacts banks' return on assets, highlighting its role in enhancing financial performance. The interaction term between artificial intelligence innovation and economic growth emphasizes their collaborative positive impact on financial performance. Mediation analysis highlights information and communication technology development's role in transforming artificial intelligence innovation into improved financial outcomes. This study highlights the essential role of artificial intelligence technology innovation in banking and finance, emphasizing the need to consider economic and technological factors for maximizing its benefits in enhancing financial performance.
